text: Good morning, Lena. It is me. I am sitting in the kitchen with your coffee cup, the blue one. I use it now, I hope that is all right.
say: Good morning, Lena. It is me. I am sitting in the kitchen with your coffee cup, the blue one. I use it now, I hope that is all right.

text: Yesterday I picked the last apples from the tree behind the house. Your father says there are too many, and then he eats four.
say: Yesterday I picked the last apples from the tree behind the house. Your father says there are too many, and then he eats four.

text: Do you remember the night we slept in the garden to count shooting stars? You counted eleven. I think about that when I look up now.
say: Do you remember the night we slept in the garden to count shooting stars? You counted eleven. I think about that when I look up now.

text: Look after yourself up there. Do the small things, even the boring ones. I want you back just as you left.
say: Look after yourself up there. Do the small things, even the boring ones. I want you back just as you left.

text: I will record again tomorrow morning. I love you. Goodbye for now.
say: I will record again tomorrow morning. I love you. Goodbye for now.

text: Hey Lena, Jonas here. The kids drew your ship again. This time it has six windows and a dog.
say: Hey Lena, Jonas here. The kids drew your ship again. This time it has six windows and a dog.

text: I finally fixed your old bike. It is waiting in the garage for when you are back.
say: I finally fixed your old bike. It is waiting in the garage for when you are back.

text: Talk tomorrow. Well, you know what I mean. Bye.
say: Talk tomorrow. Well, you know what I mean. Bye.

text: Lena, it is Priya. The whole simulator team watched your docking replay at lunch. Nobody touched their food.
say: Lena, it is Priya. The whole simulator team watched your docking replay at lunch. Nobody touched their food.

text: Your desk plant is alive. I am as surprised as you are.
say: Your desk plant is alive. I am as surprised as you are.

text: More tomorrow. Fly safe.
say: More tomorrow. Fly safe.

text: Everyone is well. Your father ate the apples I had put aside for the cake, so now it is a smaller cake. Jonas brings the children on Sunday, and Bruno sits under your chair as if you were only late for dinner.
say: Everyone is well. Your father ate the apples I had put aside for the cake, so now it is a smaller cake. Jonas brings the children on Sunday, and Bruno sits under your chair as if you were only late for dinner.

text: I miss you too, my girl. I drink from your blue cup every morning, so the kitchen feels a little less empty. And at night I look up and say good night to the sky.
say: I miss you too, my girl. I drink from your blue cup every morning, so the kitchen feels a little less empty. And at night I look up and say good night to the sky.

text: I picked the last apples and baked the cake with too much cinnamon, the way you like it. Then I sat down with my coffee and recorded this message for you. That was the best part of my day.
say: I picked the last apples and baked the cake with too much cinnamon, the way you like it. Then I sat down with my coffee and recorded this message for you. That was the best part of my day.

text: Bruno dug up my tulip bulbs again. I was cross for a moment, and then he looked at me. He still waits by the door around the time you used to come home.
say: Bruno dug up my tulip bulbs again. I was cross for a moment, and then he looked at me. He still waits by the door around the time you used to come home.

text: Of course I remember. We lay in the garden under the old blanket and you counted eleven. You said you would go up there one day, and I laughed. I am not laughing now. I am proud.
say: Of course I remember. We lay in the garden under the old blanket and you counted eleven. You said you would go up there one day, and I laughed. I am not laughing now. I am proud.

text: Good night, my dear. Think of the kitchen, the radio, and the smell of apple cake. I will record again tomorrow morning. I love you.
say: Good night, my dear. Think of the kitchen, the radio, and the smell of apple cake. I will record again tomorrow morning. I love you.

text: Everyone is fine. The kids drew your ship again, and it hangs on the fridge next to the one with six windows and a dog. Mum feeds all of us on Sunday.
say: Everyone is fine. The kids drew your ship again, and it hangs on the fridge next to the one with six windows and a dog. Mum feeds all of us on Sunday.

text: They tell the whole playground that their aunt flies to Mars. The small one asked if you can see her wave. I said yes, so please wave back.
say: They tell the whole playground that their aunt flies to Mars. The small one asked if you can see her wave. I said yes, so please wave back.

text: Fixed, oiled, and waiting in the garage. I took it for a test ride. Fine, a few test rides. When you are back, we ride to the lake.
say: Fixed, oiled, and waiting in the garage. I took it for a test ride. Fine, a few test rides. When you are back, we ride to the lake.

text: I miss you too, big sister. Nobody argues with me about the music in the car any more. It is far too peaceful.
say: I miss you too, big sister. Nobody argues with me about the music in the car any more. It is far too peaceful.

text: Good night, Lena. The kids picked a star for you tonight. Talk tomorrow. Well, you know what I mean.
say: Good night, Lena. The kids picked a star for you tonight. Talk tomorrow. Well, you know what I mean.

text: Loud and proud. We watched your docking replay again at lunch, and again nobody touched their food. Your chair is empty and nobody may sit in it. My rule.
say: Loud and proud. We watched your docking replay again at lunch, and again nobody touched their food. Your chair is empty and nobody may sit in it. My rule.

text: Alive, and I am as surprised as you are. I talk to it about flight rules. It has a new leaf, and I take full credit for that.
say: Alive, and I am as surprised as you are. I talk to it about flight rules. It has a new leaf, and I take full credit for that.

text: Simulator runs all morning with the new trainees, on your old checklist. They complained about it. I told them it was your fault.
say: Simulator runs all morning with the new trainees, on your old checklist. They complained about it. I told them it was your fault.

text: We miss you here too. Lunch is quieter without you stealing my fries. Come back and steal them.
say: We miss you here too. Lunch is quieter without you stealing my fries. Come back and steal them.

text: Good night, Lena. Fly safe. More tomorrow.
say: Good night, Lena. Fly safe. More tomorrow.

text: One thing before the next message. ORBIT asked to say this to you in its own words.
say: One thing before the next message. Orbit asked to say this to you in its own words.

text: When you have taken it, tell me the numbers. Then we go on.
say: When you have taken it, tell me the numbers. Then we go on.

text: Good to hear. ORBIT goes by the reading, not by how you feel, so it asks again.
say: Good to hear. Orbit goes by the reading, not by how you feel, so it asks again.

text: That is all Marta recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 min.
say: That is all Marta recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 minutes.

text: That is all Jonas recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 min.
say: That is all Jonas recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 minutes.

text: That is all Priya recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 min.
say: That is all Priya recorded today. What you just said is saved as your reply and reaches Earth in about 5 minutes.

text: Blood pressure has been well below your normal in this phase (Outbound to Mars: about 112/67) on two readings in a row.
say: Blood pressure has been well below your normal in this phase (Outbound to Mars: about 112 over 67) on two readings in a row.

text: Sit or lie down, drink water, and repeat the reading after 5 minutes. Tell the medical lead today.
say: Sit or lie down, drink water, and repeat the reading after 5 minutes. Tell the medical lead today.

text: Thank you. 112/70 mmHg is back in your usual range. Take it easy for an hour and check again this evening.
say: Thank you. 112 over 70 millimetres of mercury is back in your usual range. Take it easy for an hour and check again this evening.
